question: What is the primary purpose of food budgeting in dietetics?

options.A: Planning finances to meet nutritional goals sustainably
options.B: Eliminating all processed foods from household diets
options.C: Maximizing the purchase of expensive imported supplements
options.D: Reducing total daily caloric intake for weight loss

explanation: Food budgeting aligns financial resources with nutritional needs so healthy eating remains achievable over time. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h1)

question: Why do food-insecure households often consume diets high in refined carbohydrates?

options.A: Storage facilities are required to keep fresh protein items
options.B: Cheap calories take priority over micronutrient density
options.C: Refined carbohydrates taste better than local vegetables
options.D: Health workers specifically recommend starchy foods first

explanation: Limited funds force families to buy the most filling foods available, which are usually cheap refined carbohydrates rather than nutrient-dense proteins and produce. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h1)

question: Which food group provides the most affordable protein for low-income households in Nigeria?
explanation: Legumes like beans and bambara nuts offer high protein content at a fraction of the cost of animal meats. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h2)

question: A nursing mother has a strict food budget. Where should she direct her limited money first?

options.A: Nutrient-dense foods for growing children and herself
options.B: Expensive vitamin supplements from foreign pharmacies
options.C: Snacks and sugary beverages for afternoon visitors
options.D: Packaged breakfast cereals with cartoon characters

explanation: Vulnerable groups with heightened nutritional requirements take priority when allocating tight food resources. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h2)

question: What is the main advantage of creating a structured weekly meal plan?

options.A: Preventing impulsive purchases and reducing market trips
options.B: Eliminating the need to ever cook fresh meals daily
options.C: Guaranteeing zero food waste in the household forever
options.D: Ensuring every meal contains imported ingredients

explanation: Planning meals ahead stops unplanned buying and cuts down on frequent trips where extra money is spent. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h3)

question: How does batch cooking large pots of soup help a tight household budget?

options.A: It prevents family members from eating too many calories
options.B: It automatically removes the need for any protein source
options.C: It saves cooking fuel, time, and overall food costs
options.D: It makes perishable vegetables last fresh for three months

explanation: Cooking in bulk lowers energy consumption from gas or kerosene and optimizes ingredient usage. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h3)

question: When are seasonal fruits and vegetables generally cheapest in local markets?

options.D: During the middle of the dry season

explanation: Abundant supply during harvest seasons drives market prices down significantly. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h4)

question: Why is buying dry staples from wholesale markets preferred over corner shops?

options.A: Wholesale venues offer lower unit prices for bulk items
options.B: Packaged items in wholesale markets never expire
options.C: Corner shops never sell genuine food products
options.D: Wholesale locations provide free home delivery services

explanation: Buying larger quantities at wholesale rates reduces the cost per unit compared to buying small portions daily. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h4)

question: What is an effective way to handle surplus fresh vegetables before they spoil?

options.A: Storing them inside sealed warm cupboards
options.C: Leaving them exposed in direct sunlight
options.D: Soaking them in sugary water overnight

explanation: Drying or freezing excess produce preserves nutrients and prevents rapid decay. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h5)

question: Why must cooked leftovers be cooled and refrigerated promptly?

options.A: To make the food taste sweeter the next day
options.B: To prevent rapid microbial growth and food poisoning
options.C: To completely remove all calories from the dish
options.D: To change the color of the ingredients safely

explanation: Leaving cooked food at room temperature allows bacteria to multiply quickly, posing health risks. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h5)

question: Which local Nigerian vegetable is a rich source of iron and folate?
explanation: Indigenous dark greens like ugu are packed with essential micronutrients like iron and folate. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h6)

question: How do indigenous grains like millet and sorghum benefit a low-income household?

options.A: They replace the need for drinking clean water daily
options.B: They can be stored indefinitely without any containers
options.C: They provide complete animal protein without legumes
options.D: They supply complex carbohydrates and sustained energy affordably

explanation: Local grains are cost-effective energy sources that offer better nutritional value than refined imported flour products. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h6)

question: Why should health workers collaborate with clients to modify existing family recipes?

options.A: It ensures the meal plan matches their culture and budget
options.B: It forces the family to buy expensive foreign spices
options.C: It eliminates all carbohydrates from their daily diet
options.D: It guarantees the client will lose weight in one week

explanation: Adapting familiar foods makes dietary advice practical, acceptable, and sustainable for the household. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h7)

question: A client reports that market prices for beans doubled unexpectedly. What is the most appropriate next step for the dietitian?

options.A: Insist that the client must buy the beans regardless of the cost
options.B: Collaborate with the client to substitute with alternative cheap proteins
options.C: Tell the client to stop eating protein entirely for several months
options.D: Recommend expensive imported protein powders as a permanent fix

explanation: Financial plans must remain flexible, allowing substitutions when market prices fluctuate unexpectedly. [learn more](GNS227_U3_T004#GNS227_U3_T004_h7)
